name: Morgan Advanced Materials plc
summary: Morgan Advanced Materials plc manufactures and sells various carbon and ceramic products. The company operates through Thermal Products, Performance Carbon, and Technical Ceramics segments. The Thermal Products segment manufactures products, systems, and solutions, such as crucibles, foundry products, furnace industries furnace range products, insulating fibre and microporous products, firebricks and mortars, and heat shields used in industrial metal processing, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics, and glass, as well as by manufacturers of equipment for aerospace, automotive, marine, and domestic applications.
